source: Realistic indonesia train game with power lines on the side of the road. crossings, realistic audio engine sound for the cc201 on a huge realistic map. with moving cars.

image_prompt.text: A two-way road wide enough for car traffic running the length of the map alongside the rail corridor
A large open shared area the whole server draws from, set off the road somewhere along the route
a railway line for the CC201 running across a huge map, parallel to the road
power lines on poles along the side of the road for its full length
level crossings where the railway intersects the road
an Indonesian CC201 diesel locomotive standing on the track

layout_placement.text: cars that drive along the road in both directions while the train runs

notes: Preset caveat: Vehicle Sim carries a shared resource field, which this prompt neither asks for nor rules out; kept per batch policy, but it traces to the preset rather than the user.
Vehicle Sim has no lap or finish condition, and the prompt sets no goal, so this is a free-roam persistent world.
Realistic CC201 engine audio was explicitly requested and has no channel in this handoff.

open_questions.ask: Does the player drive the CC201, ride it, or watch it run - and is there anything to complete, or is it free-roam?
How long should the line run end to end? 'Huge' could mean a few thousand studs or an entire province.
Is the railway a single point-to-point line, or a loop so the train can run continuously?

coverage_missing.ask: Is the player driving the train, riding as a passenger, or observing? No win or loop condition is stated.
How many studs end to end is 'huge'?
Point-to-point line, or a continuous loop?
Should the line have stations, yards, or signals, or only the crossings you named?

answers.ask: Does the player drive the CC201, ride it, or watch it run - and is there anything to complete, or is it free-roam?
answers.answer: The player drives the CC201 in free-roam, with no required objectives.

answers.ask: How long should the line run end to end? 'Huge' could mean a few thousand studs or an entire province.
answers.answer: Make it a large but practical map with roughly 10,000 studs of railway end to end.

answers.ask: Is the railway a single point-to-point line, or a loop so the train can run continuously?
answers.answer: Use a single point-to-point railway line.
